title: Meet Singer Tyrese & Win $200 Victoria Secret Gift Card
description: Prizes: -Chance to meet Tyrese Gibson and win a personal lullaby song by him and produced by Quincey Jones III (QD3) -A year supply of Johnson & Johnson Baby Care products -$200 Giftcard to Victoria Secret  To enter: 1. Text "Baby" to 511411  2. Respond to the prompts 3. Enter "FEELRICH" for the participant code 4. Screen Shot the message that you get after which says:  "Free msg: You're also signed up for the customized messages from Feel Rich. Terms & Conditions at text4baby.org. Reply STOP to cancel text4baby messages or HELP for help." 5. Post it to your instagram, @TiffanyDarlyn and Hashtag #text4baby  You can also join by going to: http://www.text4baby.org/feelrich  ENDS DECEMBER 14th  ♡Instagram: TiffanyDarlyn ♡Follow Me: http://www.twitter.com/tiffanydarlyn ♡Vlog Channel: http://www.youtube.com/tiffanysvlogs ♡ BLOGSPOT: http://tiffany-darlyn.blogspot.com/  BUSINESS INQUIRIES: [EMAIL]

asr.full_text: Hey everyone it's Tiffany here So today I have a very very very very exciting video for you all As you can see by the title, one of you lucky ladies is going to get the opportunity to meet Are you ready? The singer, Tyrese Gibson Is that not insane?! I'm just so so excited for you guys! Now because of his schedule you won't be able to meet him in person schedule you will not be able to meet him in person but she will be able to Skype with him which is just as amazing what girl on this earth would not want to Skype with therese. But not only that Therese in KCJJ3 also known as cutie3 will create your baby their own personal lullaby so while you're chatting with Therese you can let him know your baby's physical traits, personality milestones milestones, dreams whatever you want and he will write it down and make it happen and create your baby their own lullaby. Like, is that just not amazing? But not only that! A second place winner will receive a free year supply of Johnson and Johnson baby care products. But wait, I'm not done! And one more winner will receive a $200 gift card to Victoria's Secret, $200. Like- can it get any better? I know you're wondering, how on earth did I enter this amazing giveaway? And I'm gonna let you guys know now. So I have teamed up with a company called Feel Rich as well as Johnson & Johnson, who created this free tech service called texts4baby. And texts4baby is basically a free SMS service for new moms expecting mons and friends and family members of moms. And what it does is send you three messages per week regarding your baby or your pregnancy. It's really about providing new moms and expecting moms important information that they need at this time. The texts4baby service will send new moms messages through their baby's first year and it'll send pregnant moms messages tailored to their due dates. It sends you information about breastfeeding, labor & delivery, immunizations, health & fitness during pregnancy, developmental milestones. All types of really important information for new moms out there. And some of you may or may not know but I am mother to a 1 year old and I'm also pregnant with baby number two due May 28th, 2013. And I have actually texted it over myself and I feel like it's very, very helpful. As a mom to a one year old running around, I'm always super busy with him and the Text for Babies Service reminds me of things I need t do and what I should and shouldn't do during this pregnancy, and it really helps me stay on top of things. So I definitely would recommend it to all moms out there. So what you have to do to enroll and enter this contest you have to text the word baby to 511,411 and I'm gonna put all this information in the description box so you guys can go back and check to make sure that you're enrolling properly. So text the word baby to 511,411. After that you're gonna be prompted to answer a few questions and one of them is are you pregnant and if you're pregnant you have to enter your due date and eventually it's gonna ask you for a participant code and for that participant code you have to enter feel rich and like I said I'm gonna put all this information in the description box as well as pop up pop up so that you guys can see what I'm talking about after you enter feel rich you are automatically entered into the giveaway to Skype with Therese, win the lullaby for your baby, or the free year supply of Johnson & Johnson Baby Care products. Now in order to win the $200 gift card to Victoria's Secret, you're gonna get a message after you text Feel Rich that looks like this. And what you need to do, you have to screenshot that message, post it to your Instagram, at my name, Tiffany Darlan, and hashtag TextForBaby. Now what you need to do it, you have to screenshot that message Post it to your Instagram at My Name Tiffany darlin And hashtag text4baby. Now if you cannot screenshot from your phone You can take a picture a bit from another person's phone or send that picture to your email And then upload it to your Instagram but you have to upload it to your Instagram so that I can see it At my name and and hashtag text4baby And after that you'll be automatically entered into the giveaway to win a $200.00 gift card to Victoria's Secret. Now, this contest ends on December 14 which is in two weeks so I want to make sure you guys tell all of your mom friends out there about this amazing giveaway and, you know, let them know about TXT4baby so that they can enroll and enter into win one of these amazing prizes so good luck to everyone! I love all of you guys and i'm so excited and I will see you guys in my next video bye!
